description: Divisional Sectretariat Mirigama - Land Acquisition - Kandalama, Mirigama D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of multiple land parcels for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land lots, their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
